answer: To trade, an agent must dock at a public wharf: post a 40 POA bond for a rotating cipher from a random beacon each epoch. The beacon spot-checks 5% of docked agents hourly, demanding a live compute heartbeat tied to the cipher in 60 seconds. An agent at its nadir cannot fake it in time and forfeits the bond. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 POA plus 100 machines running nonstop; an honest agent pays one bond and keeps every reward.
